result.instructions: Tools for Vindi, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which subscriptions are past due, and which customers they belong to?"; "Show me the bills and charges of customer 1042 from this month."; "List our plans and how many subscriptions each one has.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Vindi data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run vindi_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run vindi_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run vindi_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. vindi_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: vindi_get_merchant
tools.title: Get merchant
tools.description: Fetch the Vindi merchant (your company) that this API key belongs to: id, name, registry code, e-mail and status. GET /merchants/current.

tools.name: vindi_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List customers (clients) with page, per_page, a search query and sorting. Use an id from the reply with vindi_get_customer. GET /customers.

query.description: Vindi search, for example name:Paulo or status:active. Operators: : contains, = equals, > < >= <=, NOT or - negates, AND/OR with parentheses. Use the attribute names of the list.

sort_by.description: Field to sort by, for example created_at, name or status.

tools.name: vindi_get_customer
tools.title: Get customer
tools.description: Fetch one customer by id: name, e-mail, registry code, address, phones and status. GET /customers/{id}.

tools.name: vindi_create_customer
tools.title: Create customer
tools.description: Create a customer in your Vindi account. It only adds the customer record; it charges nothing. POST /customers.

registry_code.description: Tax registry number of the customer (CPF or CNPJ, as the customer gives it).

code.description: Your own code for the customer.

tools.name: vindi_update_customer
tools.title: Update customer
tools.description: Update one customer by id. The name is always sent (Vindi requires it); omitted optional fields keep their current values. PUT /customers/{id}.

registry_code.description: Tax registry number of the customer (CPF or CNPJ, as the customer gives it).

code.description: Your own code for the customer.

tools.name: vindi_list_subscriptions
tools.title: List subscriptions
tools.description: List subscriptions (recurring plans of customers) with page, per_page, a search query and sorting. Use an id with vindi_get_subscription. GET /subscriptions.

query.description: Vindi search, for example name:Paulo or status:active. Operators: : contains, = equals, > < >= <=, NOT or - negates, AND/OR with parentheses. Use the attribute names of the list.

sort_by.description: Field to sort by, for example created_at, name or status.

tools.name: vindi_get_subscription
tools.title: Get subscription
tools.description: Fetch one subscription by id: status, plan, customer, billing dates, interval and current period. GET /subscriptions/{id}.

tools.name: vindi_end_subscription
tools.title: Cancel a subscription
tools.description: Cancel one Vindi subscription by id (stops its future charges). This cancels the customer's Vindi subscription only, not your UsefulAPI plan. cancel_bills is passed to Vindi as is. DELETE /subscriptions/{id}.

cancel_bills.description: Also cancel the subscription's open bills (passed to Vindi as cancel_bills).

comments.description: A note stored with the cancellation.
